title: Markets
description: Countries the apps serve, each with its currency, time zone and defaults. Language is independent of market.
coverageNote: Enabling a market does not guarantee that station, price or car data exists for it; coverage depends on imported and verified data.
emptyBody: Add the launch market (e.g. EG) to get started.
enableBody: The market becomes selectable in the apps.
disableBody: The market is hidden from the apps. Its content is kept and can be re-enabled later.

form.codeHint: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, e.g. EG, SA, AE
form.currencyHint: Only currencies registered below can be used.
form.noCurrency: Register the currency in the Currencies section first.

validation.timezone: Choose a valid IANA time zone

defaultLocked: Default market — choose another default in Settings first.

currencies.title: Currencies
currencies.description: Currencies used by markets and prices. A market can only use a registered currency.
currencies.name: Name
currencies.deleteBody: Only a currency that no market, price or tariff uses can be deleted; otherwise the server refuses and nothing changes.
